Пока инспектор идёт по заводу, нарушения можно успеть исправить. Повторное нарушение по предписанию — двойной штраф и остановка участка.
en: Planned inspections are announced a week ahead: the checklist below shows what the inspector will look at and the fine awaiting if he came today. Sudden ones are rare and not announced. While the inspector walks the plant, violations can still be fixed. A repeat violation after an order means a double fine and a shut-down section.
